description: Needs a SpaceNexus API key with SpaceNexus Research. Multi-year annual financial fundamentals extracted deterministically from SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts (10-K, 20-F and 40-F) for public space companies: revenue, gross profit, operating income, net income, R&D expense, CapEx, operating cash flow, cash, total debt, diluted shares and same-currency margins and free cash flow. Every figure preserves its reported ISO currency and traces to its CIK, accession number, form, filing date, period end and XBRL tag.

limit.description: How many public companies to return (1 to 25).

slugs.description: Comma-separated company profile slugs, e.g. "rocket-lab,planet-labs". Omit for all tracked public space companies with an SEC CIK.

years.description: Annual fiscal years per company (1 to 5).

name: public_financials_xbrl
title: Public space financials (SEC EDGAR XBRL)
